questions.question: How is Defect Removal Efficiency defined?
options: errors found divided by errors found plus defects later
defects later divided by the total too now too now
the total divided by errors found now again here too
errors found times defects later here here again again here
options_ar: الأخطاء المكتشفة مقسومة على مجموعها مع العيوب اللاحقة
العيوب اللاحقة مقسومة على المجموع هنا أيضاً الآن
المجموع مقسوماً على الأخطاء المكتشفة الآن هنا أيضاً
الأخطاء المكتشفة مضروبة بالعيوب اللاحقة مجدداً مجدداً
options_en: errors found divided by errors found plus defects later
defects later divided by the total too now too now
the total divided by errors found now again here too
errors found times defects later here here again again here
questions.explanation: DRE is errors found before delivery over that plus the defects found afterwards.
questions.explanation_ar: DRE هي الأخطاء المكتشفة قبل التسليم على مجموعها مع العيوب المكتشفة بعده.

questions.question: How is defect density expressed?
options: defects per meeting here
defects per unit of size
defects per developer
defects per release date
options_en: defects per meeting here
defects per unit of size
defects per developer
defects per release date
questions.explanation: Density normalises the count by size, so projects of different scale can be compared.
questions.explanation_ar: الكثافة تُطبّع العدد بالحجم، فتصير المشاريع المختلفة قابلة للمقارنة.

questions.question: What does phase containment measure?
options: the cost of each phase here again here
the staff in each phase now here again
defects caught in the phase that made them
the length of each phase too now too now here
options_ar: كلفة كل مرحلة الآن هنا أيضاً الآن هنا
أفراد كل مرحلة أيضاً الآن هنا أيضاً
العيوب الملتقطة في المرحلة التي أنشأتها
طول كل مرحلة هنا مجدداً مجدداً مجدداً هنا
options_en: the cost of each phase here again here
the staff in each phase now here again
defects caught in the phase that made them
the length of each phase too now too now here
questions.explanation: A high containment rate means defects do not leak into later phases.
questions.explanation_ar: معدل احتواء عالٍ يعني أن العيوب لا تتسرب لمراحل لاحقة.

questions.question: What is mean time between failures?
questions.question_ar: ما هو متوسط الزمن بين الفشلين؟
options: the average repair time too now here too here
the total test time here again again
the release interval now here too now
the average running time between failures
options_en: the average repair time too now here too here
the total test time here again again
the release interval now here too now
the average running time between failures
questions.explanation: MTBF is a product metric of reliability, measured across operating time.
questions.explanation_ar: MTBF مقياس منتج للموثوقية، يُقاس على زمن التشغيل.

questions.question: How are defects often normalised?
options: per thousand lines of code
per thousand users here
per thousand tests now too
per thousand documents again
options_en: per thousand lines of code
per thousand users here
per thousand tests now too
per thousand documents again
questions.explanation: Defects per KLOC is the common normalised rate for comparing modules.
questions.explanation_ar: العيوب لكل ألف سطر هي المعدل المطبّع الشائع لمقارنة الوحدات.

questions.question: Why track customer-reported problems?
questions.question_ar: لماذا نتتبع المشاكل التي يبلّغ عنها العملاء؟
options: they set the price here now here
they reveal defects testing missed
they replace all testing too now here
they measure the code size again
options_ar: تقيس حجم الكود الآن هنا مجدداً
options_en: they set the price here now here
they reveal defects testing missed
they replace all testing too now here
they measure the code size again
questions.explanation: Field reports expose what the internal gates failed to catch.
questions.explanation_ar: تقارير الميدان تكشف ما فشلت بوابات الفحص الداخلية في التقاطه.

questions.question: Why is DRE useful to a test manager?
options: it shows the hardware cost too now here
it shows the code style now here too now here
it shows how much testing actually removes
it shows the team size here again again
options_en: it shows the hardware cost too now here
it shows the code style now here too now here
it shows how much testing actually removes
it shows the team size here again again
questions.explanation: A low DRE means the test stage is letting defects through to the field.
questions.explanation_ar: DRE المنخفض يعني أن مرحلة الاختبار تترك العيوب تصل للميدان.

questions.question: Why are late defects more expensive?
options: they need fewer people too now again
they take less time here again here
they need no testing now here too now here
they need rework across more artefacts
options_ar: تأخذ وقتاً أقل هنا مجدداً أيضاً
تحتاج إعادة عمل على آثار أكثر
options_en: they need fewer people too now again
they take less time here again here
they need no testing now here too now here
they need rework across more artefacts
questions.explanation: A defect found after release forces changes to code, docs and deployment at once.
questions.explanation_ar: العيب المكتشف بعد الإصدار يفرض تغيير الكود والتوثيق والنشر معاً.
